subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw support FxTwitter as a core, explicitly configured public live-read transport, and if so should the first supported contract be limited to post and thread retrieval?
rationale: Source inspection establishes that the adapter fits the architectural direction, but code evidence cannot decide whether the project should assume an ongoing support, privacy, and compatibility commitment to this third-party service.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow MVP
options.body: Approve an opt-in post/thread adapter with explicit consent, provenance, self-hosted base URL support, and no implicit fallback before expanding its capabilities.

options.title: Keep existing transports only
options.body: Decline the additional core service dependency and retain `bird` and `xurl` as the supported live-source paths.

options.title: Request an external prototype
options.body: Ask for a separate integration experiment to validate API stability and normalization before deciding on a core transport.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow MVP
recommendation.body: Approve an opt-in post/thread adapter with explicit consent, provenance, self-hosted base URL support, and no implicit fallback before expanding its capabilities.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the strongest available owner for a decision about supported core transports and third-party service policy.
